subject: memory leak in ode solver and multi_normal

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: memory leak in ode solver and multi_normal
parts:
We are plugging two serious memory leaks in the forthcoming
2.6 release (out next week):

* multi_normal()

* integrate_ode()

- Bob

messages.author: fcac2ab47b3becc5
messages.subject: Re: memory leak in ode solver and multi_normal
parts:
Hi Development Team,

One of my models relies heavily on multi_normal(), and I am wondering if there is an intended target date for the 2.6 release next week. I ask because I think Stan is great, and I would strongly prefer to use Stan to estimate my models over WinBUGS.

Thanks.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: memory leak in ode solver and multi_normal
parts:
I’m afraid our scheduling isn’t that precise.

Pretty much everything’s done and we just need to wrap it
up with release notes and make an announcement, so
CmdStan and Stan C++ should hit 2.6 this week. No
promises, though! After that, it’ll then take a few
days for the interfaces to release new versions.

- Bob
